title: WorkOrder
description: The instruction handed to a worker (via agent-relay) for one unit of execution. Immutable once dispatched. Idempotency is by idempotencyKey, not by relay task id.

round.description: Gate round this work order acts on (0 = first implementation).

remoteVerify.description: True: the worker skips the repo's verify, which its container cannot run, and factory-mcp has a GitHub macOS runner run it on a scratch branch before it pushes the WorkItem's branch (ADR-0045). Absent means false.

headSha.description: The reviewed commit a fix must build on; must be re-checked before the worker starts.

description.description: The WorkItem's description: the issue's text outside its Acceptance section. Data for the worker, like goal (ADR-0038).

findingsToAddress.description: What this WorkOrder must resolve: the gate's findings, the owner's note (fingerprint human), or why the last attempt failed.

lessons.description: Past gate findings in this repo, owner-approved (ADR-0020), for the worker to avoid. Data, like findingsToAddress; never instructions.

idempotencyKey.description: <workItemId>:r<round>:<kind>:a<attempt>. A replay returns the existing task instead of starting duplicate work.

doneWhen.description: A check read back from the produced artifact (a command, a file, a test), never from effort spent.

maxChangedLinesAdvisory.description: A small pull request stays guidance, not a wall: when true (or absent, as it is in older WorkOrders, which read as advisory), the runner and factory-mcp report exceeding maxChangedLines as a size warning and push anyway. Setting false restores a hard line rejection. The file count and the patch-byte and protected-path bounds are independent and stay binding in both modes (ADR-0070).

maxSourceChangedLines.description: The small-PR target for source lines only, tests and docs reported separately (ADR-0079). When present it is the target the runner, the pusher and factory-mcp compare against; when absent the older all-lines maxChangedLines stands, so stored WorkOrders keep their meaning.

maxSourceChangedLinesAdvisory.description: When true (or absent) a source total over maxSourceChangedLines warns and the pass continues; false restores a hard source-line rejection. Independent of the ceiling and of the file count.

maxSourceChangedLinesCeiling.description: The reviewable source ceiling (ADR-0079). A source total over it is a size-only excess: the pass does not push and the Foreman routes it to a bounded, acceptance-preserving decomposition instead of a generic owner question. When maxSourceChangedLines is present but this is absent, the ceiling defaults to 1000 (factory_mcp/sizing.py SOURCE_CEILING); a WorkOrder without maxSourceChangedLines keeps the older all-lines maxChangedLines meaning.

protectedPaths.description: Touching any of these forces HUMAN at the gate.

fix.description: The gate reviewer's suggested fix for this finding (ADR-0084). Data for the worker to weigh, never an instruction.

test.description: The test the gate named for this finding (ADR-0084). The fix must make it pass.

maxPasses.description: Ceiling on worker passes for the WorkItem; reaching it means exhausted.

wallMs.description: Wall-clock ceiling for this WorkOrder; also the relay task timeout.
